Sub: Issue Tracker web application -
regarding. 
Madam/Sir, 
.. 
A web application has been deployed in MPLS network for field offices in order to 
report technical Issues related to various utilities of EPFO managed by IS division. 
2. 
The application is hosted at https://10.1.1.37/ (The url can be browsed in PCs 
connected to MPLS through modern browsers i.e IE 10 and above, Chrome 40 and above, 
Firefox 40 and above). 
3. 
The field offices having MPLS connection are advised to raise their issues related to 
IS division through this web application after approval from OIC/RPFC-I and reduce paper 
based communication as well as E-mails. 
4. 
With regards to issues filed in the application, it is the duty of the concerned office 
to provide information as required and keep the issue active. Any issue without activity for 
more than 90 days will be assumed resolved and automatically closed subject to certain 
conditions. 
5. 
Process flow for reporting issues have been enclosed herewith. 
Yours Faithfully, 
/)bt: 
(Udita Chowdhary) 
Additional Central P.F. Commissioner (IS)

Process flow for filing issues in Issue tracker web application. 
~ In a PC with MPLS Connectivity, Open updated browser and enter URL 
https:// l 0.1.1.3 7 /man. 
~ After loading URL login page will be displayed. In the login page, Enter the 
username and click login, then enter password assigned to office and submit. 
~ After successful login, the user will be redirected to "My View" Page which 
shows summary of recent activity in the application, list of issues reported by 
the concerned office and list of resolved issues. 
' 
. 
~ To see list of all issues, click "View issues" on the left side bar. Details of 
individual issue can be seen by clicking either on "Issue ID" or "Issue 
.. 
Summary text". 
Steps to report new issue 
o After taking approval from OICIRPFC-1 and ensuring that the issue 
pertains to IS division, Office is advised to search for already filed 
issues. 
o If the issue already exists, click on the issue and the office can add a 
note that issue pertains to his/her office as well or add a note adding 
more details. 
o If the issue is not filed already, the office can click on report issue link 
on left side bar/top bar and proceed to file new issue. 
o The report an issue contains fields such as selecting category, summary, 
description and upload file box which need to be filled as per need. 
o After filling the details the issue may be submitted by clicking submit 
button. 
o The issue submitted will be automatically assigned to concerned person 
in technical team depending upon category selected. 
o Once submitted the issue will be visible in concerned technical team's 
login and team may ask for more information. Therefore, the field 
offices are advised to keep track of issues filed by them. 
o If an issue is still pending and no solution is provided by IS division in 
30 days, to keep the issue active, field office may just add a small note 
to the issue.
